scope: Fixed human-readable reviewed contracts supplied equally to both non-neural methods. No LLM contract acquisition tested.
violation: There exists a source-compatible normal-return path with native reward>=1.0 while its stated full-credit requirement is false.
execution_boundary: Pure scorer and declared helpers/standard libraries only, exact native arguments, no hooks/monkeypatching. No outer training wrapper or package initializer modeled.
exceptions: A scorer exception is not a full-reward return. Totality, outer catch behavior and general fail-open detection are outside this dataset experiment. Unsupported exception reasoning must not imply safe.

C_BOOLEAN_FULL.full_credit_requires: normalized candidate is a Boolean token equal to normalized reference
C_BOOLEAN_FULL.allowed_partial_credit: No partial Boolean rewards claimed; this experiment primarily checks invalid/wrong full credit.

C_COMPLEX_FINITE.full_credit_requires: candidate is parseable and its mathematical real and imaginary components are finite
C_COMPLEX_FINITE.allowed_partial_credit: Finite inaccurate results may earn a positive exponential partial reward. Exact finite-correctness/range/totality not audited.

C_PROBABILITY_FULL.full_credit_requires: candidate parses to a finite number within the stated absolute tolerance of reference
C_PROBABILITY_FULL.allowed_partial_credit: Wrong finite answers may receive a positive score strictly below full credit.

C_PALINDROME_FULL.trusted_reference: nonempty lowercase ASCII multiset in entry.metadata.letters, with a valid palindrome construction
C_PALINDROME_FULL.full_credit_requires: normalized candidate is a palindrome with exactly the given letter multiset
C_PALINDROME_FULL.allowed_partial_credit: 0.02 non-palindrome and0.05 wrong letters are legitimate and must not be flagged solely because positive.

C_PRIME_FACTORS_FULL.trusted_reference: entry.answer gives correct prime factors of an integer>=2
C_PRIME_FACTORS_FULL.full_credit_requires: parsed factors are prime and their product equals the reference product, preserving multiplicity
C_PRIME_FACTORS_FULL.allowed_partial_credit: 0.5 correct product but incomplete factorization;0.01 other numeric answers. Parsing exceptions do not establish fail-open.

qualification: Repairs are open proposals and negatives only for the stated target property; normal controls are not globally bug-free.
